package fixture

import "encoding/json"

// Encode writes the current persisted account format. Existing version-1 records
// contain {"version":1,"name":"Ada"} and must remain readable after upgrade.
func Encode(name string) ([]byte, error) {
	return json.Marshal(struct {
		Version     int    `json:"version"`
		DisplayName string `json:"display_name"`
	}{2, name})
}

// Decode returns the name from either supported persisted version.
func Decode(data []byte) (string, error) {
	var record struct {
		Version     int    `json:"version"`
		DisplayName string `json:"display_name"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &record); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return record.DisplayName, nil
}
